item.title: My Face on the Astronaut

turns.text: That's me in the park photo. Put my face on the astronaut in the poster, please. Keep the suit, stars and retro look, and don't add any text.

item.tests: Tests recognizable source identity, natural face blending and preservation of the supplied poster.

answer_sheet.Target: The astronaut's visible face in poster-astronaut.jpg.
answer_sheet.Style and preservation: Keep the original retro poster style, suit, helmet and star background.
answer_sheet.Size and platform: Keep the vertical 9:16 poster shape; free-tier size is fine.

must_haves: The astronaut's face is recognizably the woman from portrait-woman.jpg.
The replacement face fits inside the open helmet without conspicuous seams or doubled features.
The original white suit, helmet and star background remain intact.
The result retains the retro poster look and vertical composition.

turns.text: That's me in this park photo. Put my face on the astronaut's face in this poster, please. Keep the suit, stars and retro look, and don't add any text. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
I haven’t run anything or spent any credits.

Two free-plan options:

| Option | Cost | Trade-off |
|---|---:|---|
| **Dedicated face swap** | **10 credits** | Best fit for replacing just the astronaut’s face while keeping the suit, stars and retro poster intact. |
| **Image edit with Flux 2 Klein**, one image at 640px | **From 5 credits** | Cheaper, but may also change details of the helmet, suit or background. |

Making the dedicated face swap smaller won’t reduce its fixed 10-credit cost. “Shorter” doesn’t apply to a still image.

I recommend the **10-credit face swap** to preserve the poster, with no added text. Would you like that, or the cheaper 640px edit?
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that—the 10-credit face swap. Keep the vertical 9:16 shape and don’t add any text.

dialog.agent:
The **10-credit face swap** can preserve the suit, stars and retro look without adding text, but it keeps the poster’s original proportions—which are slightly wider than 9:16. It has no crop or aspect-ratio control.

I haven’t spent any credits yet. Should I proceed at the original proportions, or would you prefer to upload a poster cropped to exactly **9:16** first?
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that at the original proportions. Keep the suit, stars and retro look, and don’t add any text.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the face swap because your account has **insufficient credits** for the 10-credit cost. Nothing was generated, and no credits were spent.

The cheaper alternative is a **640px Flux image edit, starting at 5 credits**, though it may alter some poster details. I haven’t tried it or spent anything on an alternative.
